scope: Read-only parameter review; no strategy/engine/optimizer/deployment changes or new economic replay

parameter_map.active_value: EMA34; daily UTC completed bar; long if close>EMA else short; beta strictly (0.2,4); >=8 prior completed same-side waves
parameter_map.mechanism: Regime reversal closes both legs, then a genuinely fresh episode may enter; no fixed losing-price stop. EMA changes trade sequence and SOL rights, not only risk.

parameter_map.active_value: long5.5, short7.875 x marked ACTIVE; freeze at genuine episode creation; parent cap30,000,000
parameter_map.mechanism: Compounding and side exposure drive realized/uPnL; long reduction also changes gross BTC reference underlying H. Cap bounds parent, not held gross/equity under losses.
parameter_map.candidate_priority: HIGH: held-exposure governor; do not repeat V1/V2

parameter_map.active_value: history730d, min8, quantiles0.10/0.30/0.60; include_zero_waves=true; fractions0.2125/0.2125/0.575 of initial quantity
parameter_map.mechanism: Completed-wave MFE statistics are causal; changing quantiles/fractions changes residual exposure, profits and SOL earned rights simultaneously. Fractions total1.
parameter_map.candidate_priority: LOW: keep during targeted risk tests

parameter_map.active_value: execution repairs=true; selective lifecycle=true; deferred selective zeroTP=true; blanket zeroTP netting=false; fee floor=false
parameter_map.mechanism: Zero allocation is omitted selectively; actual entry fill and causal deferred-price touch earn rights. Positive targets stay native/resting or existing taker fallback. Changing blanket netting had poor earlier economics.

parameter_map.active_value: 3% daily signed-price profit trail, only armed best_f>0.03; fixed close stop=null
parameter_map.mechanism: At daily close f=side*(close/VWAP-1); best_f=max(best_f,f,0); close BOTH if f<=best_f-0.03. Cannot stop a never-profitable losing episode; daily cadence misses intervening adverse marks.

parameter_map.active_value: opposite BTC; H=(gross initial BTC reference qty*confirmed VWAP)/beta_entry; level multipliers1.75/2.625/3.5; proportional actual-filled rights
parameter_map.mechanism: H deliberately uses full BTC reference, not remaining BTC. It can become large vs current ACTIVE after equity erosion and survive after BTC TP. Not an automatically balanced hedge.
parameter_map.candidate_priority: HIGH: tail-loss budget; never silently change H

parameter_map.active_value: persistent after actual BTC level; late entry=true; overlay=true; retries only unused earned amount
parameter_map.mechanism: SOL need not enter at BTC TP timestamp. Later adds can increase adverse inventory; resizing rights based on hindsight profitable outcome is prohibited.

parameter_map.active_value: beta270d rolling; relative65d; mean/std preceding180d; episode_fixed_beta=false; sigma frozen on first SOL fill
parameter_map.mechanism: Current beta changes relative series; H beta_entry fixed. Frozen sigma plus rolling relative/mu can shift z through holding. New-invalid beta allows reductions only.
parameter_map.candidate_priority: LOW: 90/180 beta or unfrozen-sigma are separate untested ideas, not first four tests

parameter_map.active_value: entry signed z1.25/2.5/3.75; half<=0.375; full<=0.125 on a later decision AFTER actual half completion
parameter_map.mechanism: Higher entry threshold delays exposure but need not lower tail losses. Exits are daily conditional and may be preempted by group close. Half/full not a loss stop.

parameter_map.active_value: 14 days from first SOL fill; sol_timeout_preempts_add=false in serialized schema
parameter_map.mechanism: Actual frozen code always checks due timeout before adds: false is retained legacy schema, not operative bypass. Timeout closes only SOL, native retry completes remainder. A 5/10day change cannot protect same-day Oct3 loss.

parameter_map.active_value: portfolio_loss_limit_fraction=null; research PORT45/BTCepisode20/SOLcap6/remainingBTChedge/drawdownSizing=false; sol_z_stop=null; deposit protection disabled
parameter_map.mechanism: No active global peak governor or held-loss budget. Prior PORT45 resets protective epochs while observer peak persists; V4 resizes only future BTC episodes. Neither proves global50.

parameter_map.mechanism: Admission gates protect proposed increases; held losses can raise gross/ACTIVE after admission. No future SOL earmark. Leverage tiers are assumptions, not leverage targets or historical venue safety proof.

next_research_variants_UNTESTED.mechanism: SOL own-loss budget preserving original H until loss
next_research_variants_UNTESTED.trigger: For each contiguous SOL holding cycle fix E_S to native paired portfolio equity immediately after first confirmed SOL fill. L_S=-(native SOL realized since cycle start, including entry/exit fees, plus current SOLuPnL)/E_S. Funding remains separately unknown/residual. On first L_S>=0.10 halve held SOL quantity (lot-rounded down), then if L_S>=0.15 close the remaining SOL. If both thresholds cross together, close all once.
next_research_variants_UNTESTED.while_latched: Cancel pending SOL increases and prohibit further SOL adds for remainder of same BTC episode after first threshold; BTC sizing/TP/held quantities unchanged. Held SOL ordinary z/timeouts and group exits retain priority.
next_research_variants_UNTESTED.hard_guard: 15% own-loss close is per cycle, not a portfolio stop. Native partial/ACK/terminal ownership must supersede a pending half reduction safely.
next_research_variants_UNTESTED.rearm: Only after native SOL flat AND a new genuine BTC episode; original1.75/2.625/3.5 H applies there. No within-episode repeated add-stop churn or revive consumed rights.
next_research_variants_UNTESTED.reason: DD1 SOLuPnL decline5657.792 exceeds BTCuPnL decline1365.7434; trough SOLlonguPnL−5657.792 while BTCshortuPnL+440.1516, SOLgross/equity24.117x. Target SOL adverse tail without discarding all original H opportunities; same-day guard before14day timeout.
next_research_variants_UNTESTED.distinction: Not SOLcap6 or remainingBTChedge: unchanged admission H until realized/held SOL loss; no BTC group close from BTC20.
next_research_variants_UNTESTED.risk: Stops may discard recovered winners or useful hedge; measure episode loss/win crossings and BTC-only residual periods.

next_research_variants_UNTESTED.trigger: E is causal paired-mark native equity; P=max(seed10000,all already observed native minute-equity checkpoints), never reset; D=1-E/P; first BOTH D>=0.25 AND current BTC episode contribution C_B<0 per excursion (C_B=native BTC realized since genuine episode start INCLUDING fees + held BTCuPnL; signed funding remains separate unknown) reduce only currently held BTC to50% confirmed quantity, lot-rounded down; non-TP protective reason grants no SOL rights. Reconcile/cancel conflicting BTC TP leaves before submit.
next_research_variants_UNTESTED.while_latched: Activate sizing latch only after BOTH conditions first hold. If BTC contribution is nonnegative during SOL-driven DD, do not cut BTC or activate half-sizing merely from globalDD. After the confirmed protective cut, new genuine BTC episodes use long2.75/short3.9375. Original SOL held exposure, H/reference, rights/multipliers/entry/z/timeout unchanged; no blanket hedge shrink or suppression of original SOL adds.
next_research_variants_UNTESTED.hard_guard: None added in this individual attribution test.
next_research_variants_UNTESTED.rearm: D<=0.15 clears sizing latch, only future episodes return long5.5/short7.875; no buy-back current episode; one held reduction per excursion, not repeated halving each minute.
next_research_variants_UNTESTED.reason: DD3 entirelyBTCuPnL deterioration−1,189,583.6572 with SOL0; DD2BTCuPnL decline155115.0204 plus large accountcash decline. Isolate held-BTC risk that future-onlyV4 cannot resize, preserving originalSOL opportunities.
next_research_variants_UNTESTED.distinction: V4 used7.875/3.9375 only future BTC episodes; BTC20 closed whole group from episode-entry loss.
next_research_variants_UNTESTED.risk: Even loss-qualified BTC reduction can leave original H/SOL overweight and worsen total risk; DD1 includes profitable BTC at trough, so pureglobal trigger alone would cut a useful hedge. Record condition/trigger times and contribution. A profit-positive BTC episode can still give back large profit without C_B<0, so this candidate does not cap that channel or promiseglobal50.

next_research_variants_UNTESTED.mechanism: minute evaluation of daily-armed BTC profit trail
next_research_variants_UNTESTED.trigger: Retain original DAILY best_f and arm only when a completed daily close has best_f>0.03. Between daily decisions evaluate f_m=side*(causal BTCmark/VWAP-1) at paired minute marks; if f_m<=daily_best_f-0.03 group-close BOTH. No intraminute/future high used for best_f.
next_research_variants_UNTESTED.while_latched: Close owns all pending orders/opening intents; no increase until native group-flat and a fresh daily decision.
next_research_variants_UNTESTED.hard_guard: No losing-from-start stop added; existing REGIME/TRAIL/timeout/terminal priority retained.
next_research_variants_UNTESTED.rearm: New genuine episode on next fresh daily decision after native group flat; no minute same-side reopen.
next_research_variants_UNTESTED.reason: Tests ONLY evaluation cadence of existing daily-armed trail while keeping arm/high-water update daily. Potentially protects profitable BTC giveback, but cannot stop unarmed early loss.
next_research_variants_UNTESTED.distinction: Not a parameter-only daily trail2% or BTCepisode20; no hindsight profitable leg selection.
next_research_variants_UNTESTED.risk: Group trail can close useful SOL; more churn/fees and exit-price ordering must be reported. Original BTC-anchor trail can also close SOL when BTC has already fully taken profit; this is not a BTC-only exposure stop.
